summary: Available reporting indicates a cautiously bullish crypto backdrop: Bitcoin has held support, ETF flows reportedly returned positive, and Michaël van de Poppe sees an upside trigger above $84,000. Altcoin momentum is selective, while macro and equity sentiment cannot be verified sufficiently from the available results.
